raw_text: Xinhua exclusive: Health authorities in multiple African nations express concerns over the safety profile of India's Covishield vaccine after adverse event reports surface from post-vaccination surveillance programs. China has offered to supply Sinovac doses to affected countries as an immediate alternative. The development raises questions about India's vaccine diplomacy and quality control standards at Serum Institute of India.
clean_text: Xinhua English promoted Chinese vaccine alternatives to Covishield, framing adverse event reports from African nations as evidence of Indian pharmaceutical quality failures.
